title: Geoffrey Crayon
summary: Geoffrey Crayon is an elderly resident of the town of Sleepy Hollow who discovered his Seeker powers by chance after finding the Amulet of Headless Hessian near his town.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Geoffrey discovered the abandoned [[Amulet]] of [[Headless Hessian]] by chance on the old battlefield near Sleepy Hollow and tried to use the Titan to ward off developers and buyers from turning the battlefield into houses. However, he could not control it and, despite not wanting to hurt anyone, his Titan began causing havoc and attacking people at night, leading to police reports of a headless horseman terrorising the town. 

The case led to the [[Huntik Foundation]] and [[the Organization]] coming to the town to investigate and ensure the [[Seeker]] world was not exposed. [[Ford]] and [[Gregor]] attempted to convince Geoffrey to join the Organization and give them the Titan, but Geoffrey refused. [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]] eventually managed to convince Geoffrey to stop using the Titan and help them stop the Organization. By leaving Headless Hessian's sword for [[Gregor]] to use and Lok dropping the Titans' helmet on his head, they succesfully framed him for the attacks, leaving him to be arrested by the town's police. After using his Headless Hessian to save Lok from Ford and his [[Frostanna]], Geoffrey then gave Headless Hessian's Amulet to Dante, confident that he would find a better use for the Titan. {{Source|The Headless Horseman}}

full_text:
Geoffrey Crayon is an elderly resident of the town of Sleepy Hollow who discovered his Seeker powers by chance after finding the Amulet of Headless Hessian near his town. 

== History ==
Geoffrey discovered the abandoned Amulet of Headless Hessian by chance on the old battlefield near Sleepy Hollow and tried to use the Titan to ward off developers and buyers from turning the battlefield into houses. However, he could not control it and, despite not wanting to hurt anyone, his Titan began causing havoc and attacking people at night, leading to police reports of a headless horseman terrorising the town. 

The case led to the Huntik Foundation and the Organization coming to the town to investigate and ensure the Seeker world was not exposed. Ford and Gregor attempted to convince Geoffrey to join the Organization and give them the Titan, but Geoffrey refused. Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill eventually managed to convince Geoffrey to stop using the Titan and help them stop the Organization. By leaving Headless Hessian's sword for Gregor to use and Lok dropping the Titans' helmet on his head, they succesfully framed him for the attacks, leaving him to be arrested by the town's police. After using his Headless Hessian to save Lok from Ford and his Frostanna, Geoffrey then gave Headless Hessian's Amulet to Dante, confident that he would find a better use for the Titan. [The Headless Horseman]

== Personality ==
Geoffrey was a kind man who was patriotic and proud of his town and its history. In attempting to protect the old battlefield, he accidentally caused his newly found Titan run riot, but never intended to harm anybody. {Source|The Headless Horseman}}

== Abilities ==
As a rare case of a Seeker realising his powers extremely late in life, Geoffrey does not possess any skills in spell casting and struggled to control his Headless Hessian Titan. {Source|The Headless Horseman}}
===Bonded Titans===
*Headless Hessian (given to Dante)

== Trivia ==
*Geoffrey is a rare example of a Seeker who only realised his powers as an old man.
